description: Apparent geocentric and topocentric places of the Sun, Moon and planets.
notes: Time: every instant is its calendar value read as UT1 (DUT1 = 0, the same assumption as LodestarKit's JulianDate(date:)); TT = UT1 + DeltaT with DeltaT from Skyfield's builtin tables (IERS daily values 1973-01-02..2027-01-23, Stephenson/Morrison/Hohenkerk splines and parabola elsewhere). No IERS download, no polar motion.

Bodies are DE440s targets: sun, moon, mercury and venus (body centres) and the system barycentres of Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune (DE440s has no body-centre segments for these; the offset is below 0.07 arcsec).

ra_apparent_j2000_deg, dec_apparent_j2000_deg: geocentric apparent direction (light time, light deflection, annual aberration) on the ICRS axes, which are the mean equator and equinox of J2000.0 to within 20 mas; this is the direction of LodestarKit's BodyState.geocentricJ2000, before precession and nutation.
ra_apparent_deg, dec_apparent_deg: the same direction in the true equator and equinox of date (IAU 2006 precession, IAU 2000A nutation). distance_au: geocentric, light-time corrected.
ra_topo_deg, dec_topo_deg: topocentric apparent place in the same frame, seen from the site of the same case (WGS84; includes parallax and diurnal aberration).
az_deg (from North toward East) and alt_deg: topocentric, geometric (no atmospheric refraction) altitude of the body's centre.

illuminated_fraction = (1 + cos(phase_angle_deg)) / 2, phase_angle_deg the geocentric Sun-body-Earth angle (Skyfield astrometric.phase_angle(sun); the Sun's position is taken at the observation instant). elongation_deg: angle between the geocentric apparent directions of the body and the Sun. All three are null for the Sun.
heliocentric_distance_au (planets only): Sun-planet distance with both bodies at the instant the light left the planet (observation time minus light time).
apparent_magnitude (planets only): Mallama and Hilton (2018) via Skyfield magnitudelib; null if the model is undefined (NaN), which does not happen for these instants.
